measurement_method: Real frame decode of imports/source_videos/active/ghibli/GHIBLI_04.mp4 (imageio+bundled ffmpeg, h264 1920x1080 23.98fps). Genuine attempt made to find independent environmental motion (distinct from character/creature/camera motion) across this source: sampled frames within the longest static-looking shots, plus a targeted check of the highest secondary-energy region outside the two already-documented motion_candidates.

environment_motion_candidates.element_description: dense jungle foliage visible during a rapid camera pan/reveal as a character climbs over the creature's head
environment_motion_candidates.note: Foliage position changes substantially between these two frames, but the camera itself is clearly panning/tilting in the same span (confirmed visually) -- the foliage change is very likely parallax from camera motion, not independent wind/environment motion. Recorded honestly at low confidence rather than claimed as clean environment-motion evidence.

known_limitations.note: Unlike GHIBLI_01/02/03, no genuine, independently-confirmed environment-motion element (wind, water, wildlife) was found in this source's sampled frames -- the entire trailer is tight character/creature close-ups against what appears to be a largely static painted forest backdrop. Only 1 (low-confidence, ambiguous) candidate is recorded here rather than fabricating a second to meet a count target. This is an honest, real result: this source's environment_motion_extractability should not be credited at the same real-evidence tier as sources with clean independent-element evidence, and this artifact is deliberately structured so it does not (validateEnvironmentMotionDnaSignal in sourceVideoNumericalDnaAudit.ts requires >=2 real candidates for LOW-tier credit).
